# CalGrid Template Tasks & Design Notes

## Overview

- **Source:** ColorLib Calendar 12 (`calendar-12`)
- **New Name:** `calgrid`
- **Deploy Target:** `calgrid.free.componentdock.com`

## Structure & Sections

1. **Header / Navbar / Centered Hero Content:**
   - Minimalist centered header with title and subtitle description.
2. **Date Picker Form Component:**
   - Clean input field matching the original Bootstrap form layout.
   - Interactive calendar dropdown (using React state or lightweight date picker logic to meet all test criteria).
3. **Footer:**
   - Standard footer linking `https://www.componentdock.com/`.

## Design Notes

- Font: Roboto sans-serif.
- Clean minimalist aesthetic with generous vertical padding (`py-28`).
- Muted grays (`#b3b3b3`) for helper text.
